rationale: P identifies the vehicle braking behavior that must be characterized to evaluate prevention of unintended braking. H-3 explicitly concerns a sudden stop without an obstacle ahead, and SG-3 establishes unintended braking itself as the behavior to prevent. The declared scope matches H-3's operational situation. P does not expand into sensing, computation, communication, failure mitigation, or mechanism-specific timing requirements.
determining_elements: “Braking behavior of the ego vehicle” identifies the system behavior directly required by the Evaluation Target.
“Whether braking occurs when no obstacle is present in front of the vehicle” is supported by H-3's hazardous event.
The scope retains H-3's straight-ahead urban driving situation at 50 km/h, with no visible obstacles or vehicles ahead and good weather.
